Deathmatch
%message%
Every one for themselves, %size% fighters in the %map%. Everyone spawns somewhere on the field and comes back somewhere else %respawn% seconds after dying. Free places are filled with fake players of your level.
Everyone else is attacked without Ctrl, and no kill gives karma. Every kill gives a Sealed Cache%kill%. After %fight% minutes the most kills wins: %reward% for the best player.%top%
A party plays as its members alone: there are no friends in a Deathmatch.
